template.name: Landledger: approve an infrastructure change
template.description: A form (or a pull request webhook) asks for an infrastructure change with its monthly cost: Landledger raises an infra_change request with the evidence and asks the cost center’s approvers. When they decide, the approval goes on to the step that applies the change (a placeholder to fill) and a Slack post; a rejection is posted with the approver’s comment.

credentials.name: Landledger
credentials.description: Landledger's API URL (in the cluster http://landledger-api.landflow-dev.svc.cluster.local:4810, on this machine http://127.0.0.1:4810) and an ll_ key with requests:write and read. Managing the webhook needs an admin key, or put the whsec_ secret of a webhook an admin made in Webhook Signing Secret.

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.description: A bot token (xoxb-…) with chat:write, invited to #infra-changes.

credentials.name: Webhook secret
credentials.description: The header (e.g. X-Webhook-Token) and secret your CI sends with a pull request’s cost.

setup: Pick or add the **Landledger** credential: the API URL and an `ll_` key with `requests:write` and `read`. To let **Request decided** register its webhook, the key needs `admin`; otherwise have a Landledger admin add one for its URL and put the `whsec_` secret in the credential.
Pick the **Slack bot** for the two posts and set their channel (#infra-changes).
Ask with the form at `/form/infra-change`, or let CI post the same fields to the **Pull request webhook** with the **Webhook secret** header.
**Raised by this flow** joins a decision to this flow by the request’s origin, so the flow answers only for requests it raised.
Replace **Apply the change** with what applies it (merge, deploy, comment on the PR), then add Landledger **Request → Mark Applied** so the request reads applied.
Publish: the form and webhook go live and Landledger starts sending request.decided to this flow (it must reach `LANDFLOW_PUBLIC_URL`).

workflow.name: Landledger: approve an infrastructure change
workflow.description: A form or pull request webhook raises an infra_change request in Landledger; its decision is applied (placeholder) or posted as a rejection.

parameters.formDescription: Landledger asks the cost center’s approvers; you hear back here when they decide.

options.formSubmittedText: Sent to Landledger: the approvers have it now.

nodes.name: Pull request webhook
nodes.notes: A CI job posts { title, costCenter, monthlyAmount, requester, pullRequestUrl, note, basis } when a pull request adds infrastructure cost.

nodes.name: Ask Landledger
nodes.notes: Raises the request; the approvers decide in Landledger (or in Slack with the "Ask the approver in Slack" flow). The answer comes back through Request decided below.

nodes.name: Raised by this flow
nodes.notes: Joins the decision to this flow by the request’s origin: requests other flows or people raised pass by.

nodes.name: Apply the change
nodes.notes: Placeholder: put the step that applies the change here (merge the pull request, run the pipeline, comment on the PR with the GitHub node), then a Landledger Request → Mark Applied with the request id.
